name: avatar-group-compact
title: Avatar Group Compact
description: A compact avatar group component with pill-shaped container, overlapping avatar stack, and overflow count. Uses namespace exports: AvatarGroupCompact.Root, AvatarGroupCompact.Stack, AvatarGroupCompact.Overflow.

docs.lead: A compact avatar group component with pill-shaped container, overlapping avatar stack, and overflow count.
docs.usage:
import * as AvatarGroupCompact from "@/components/ui/avatar-group-compact"
import * as Avatar from "@/components/ui/avatar"

<AvatarGroupCompact.Root>
  <AvatarGroupCompact.Stack>
    <Avatar.Root>
      <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
    </Avatar.Root>
  </AvatarGroupCompact.Stack>
  <AvatarGroupCompact.Overflow>+3</AvatarGroupCompact.Overflow>
</AvatarGroupCompact.Root>

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The default variant with shadow and the stroke variant with a ring border around the container.

examples.title: Size
examples.description: Compact avatar groups come in 3 sizes: 40 (default), 32, and 24.

api.name: AvatarGroupCompact.Root
api.description: The main pill-shaped container with shadow and optional stroke border.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the avatars and overflow text. Propagated to child components.

api.name: AvatarGroupCompact.Stack
api.description: Container for the overlapping avatar stack.

api.name: AvatarGroupCompact.Overflow
api.description: Text element showing the count of additional avatars.
